policy: Exact pins, no floating ranges — the same policy tools/visual-engine/VERSION_LOCK.json states. Upgrades re-run `node tools/mermaid-engine/test.mjs` and a full `python3 -m tools.health --full` (BUILD-01 renders every doc-system document through render.mjs) before re-pinning.
_why_this_file_exists: tools/mermaid-engine/render.mjs EXECUTES at build time, so this lockfile is an execution surface — yet STRUCT-09 attested only tools/visual-engine/package-lock.json, hardcoded by path, while `git ls-files '*package-lock.json'` returned TWO tracked lockfiles. The only thing that read this one was tools/docgen/build_cache.py, and it reads it as a CACHE-INVALIDATION fingerprint: it rebuilds when the lockfile changes, it never refuses. STRUCT-09 now DERIVES its subject set from the tracked lockfiles and requires a sibling VERSION_LOCK.json for each, so a third package directory arrives already covered.
_npm_lockfile_sha256_note: Re-derived 2026-10-16 (engine 1.1.2): the only lockfile change is the root entry's `license` field, MIT -> Apache-2.0, when the repository adopted the Apache-2.0 licence; no package added, removed or re-versioned. Previous value 617e881e24ad7f54... Derived 2026-08-23 from the committed lockfile, read first: 3 packages, one direct dependency (beautiful-mermaid 1.1.3) and its two transitives (elkjs, entities), every one an exact pin with an integrity hash. Re-derive with: python3 -c "import hashlib,pathlib;print(hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('tools/mermaid-engine/package-lock.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())"
